headline: Week 7 late games: Brissett is active and starting, Golden has no designation and is expected to play. No new swaps. Confirm Packers inactives by 11:55 AM Pacific and add a kicker before 1:05 PM Pacific.
alerts: Breece Hall was inactive at 10:00 AM Pacific. If he is still in your lineup it is locked now and scores zero, nothing more to do.
Jacoby Brissett is active and starting. Arizona's only backup QB Carson Beck is inactive. Kickoff 1:05 PM Pacific vs. Denver.
Broncos CB Pat Surtain II is inactive, a boost for Arizona's passing game.

Matthew Golden and MarShawn Lloyd: the official Packers inactives list was not posted yet at 12:05 PM Pacific. Golden had no game designation and was reported cleared to play. Check the app before 1:25 PM Pacific. If Golden is ruled inactive, slide MarShawn Lloyd into his FLEX spot if Golden is there, since Lloyd is your only bench player left in a late game.
You still need a kicker. Add Jake Bates (DET, 1:25 PM Pacific) or Chad Ryland (ARI, 1:05 PM Pacific) before kickoff, or the K slot scores zero.
Saquon Barkley is expected to play Monday per NFL Network, a small negative for the Cowboys defense matchup but no lineup change.
Sleeper could not be reached this run, so the roster is from an earlier run. Confirm your lineup in the app.

ARI.note: Hosts Denver Sunday 1:05 PM Pacific in Glendale. RB Jeremiyah Love and QB2 Carson Beck inactive. Broncos CB Pat Surtain II and S Talanoa Hufanga inactive.

GB.note: At Detroit Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific. Lions -3, total 53.5. Jacobs activated and expected to debut. LB Zaire Franklin out. Official inactives pending at last check.

DET.note: Vs. Green Bay Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific. About 28 implied. C Cade Mays and DB Brian Branch questionable.

ATL.note: Vs. San Francisco Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. 49ers -2.5, total 49.5, line moved toward Atlanta. Brian Robinson out.

MIN.note: Vs. Indianapolis Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Vikings -6.5, total 41.5. Jordan Mason (thumb) is active.

IND.note: At Minnesota Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. CB Sauce Gardner and TE Tyler Warren inactive, Gould also out.

NYJ.note: Vs. Miami Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Jets -4.5, total 39.5. Breece Hall inactive for the third straight game. Dolphins LB Willie Gay inactive.

DAL.note: At Philadelphia Monday 5:15 PM Pacific. Cowboys -4 to -4.5, total 44.5. WR KaVontae Turpin and T Drew Shelton out. Pickens no game status.

PHI.note: Vs. Dallas Monday 5:15 PM Pacific. DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks out. Barkley (hamstring) questionable but reported as playing.

NO.note: Vs. Pittsburgh in Paris Sunday 6:30 AM Pacific, the earliest lock. Steelers -3.5, total 44.5. Saints inactives: G Cesar Ruiz, DL Nathan Shepherd, Kendre Miller active.
